note: Role: contract research organisation (preclinical/analytical testing) at Devarhosahally, Somapura Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk, Karnataka — the customs rows are test articles, placebos and reference standards sent in for analysis (e.g. 'FOR TEST OR ANALYSIS PUPROSE ONLY', 'FOR RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY', 'F O C - FOR TESTING USE ONLY'), not commercial goods trade. No evidence of domestic supply found in the sources read — not a negative finding, simply unverified. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the sources read). No CIN/PAN retrieved.
